challenge.method: Removed the line-leading comment markers from the initial README header. Compared the passage ending at the disclaimer with both pinned SPDX texts and tested a broader boundary extending through the contact paragraph. Checked the attribution and dates against the project README, its V3.0 heading and SPDX's tree-level cross-reference.
challenge.results: The bounded passage ends with the disclaimer's reference to the user and gives 96 matching ordered tokens in all three texts. Extending the passage through the contact information yields 131 primary tokens. The copyright dates and Paul Vixie attribution agree. The README labels V3.0 as December 27, 1993 and mentions earlier versions beyond the notice. The SPDX reference targets the same repository commit at tree level and carries match=false. Direct comparison of the exact README passage establishes the bounded token match. Wrapping and spacing still differ after marker removal.

limitations: The primary boundary is the opening Paul Vixie notice through its disclaimer in the captured V3.0 README. The contact paragraph, subsequent README content and other versions are outside scope.
SPDX evidence is fixed to data commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48. The supplied 3.29.0 label was used with that pin.
The finding covers documentary correspondence. Legal equivalence, rights for other works, text reuse, installation and Index lifecycle are outside scope.
